description:
Learn how to create playable ads with Unity PlayWorks, the ad format that lets players try your game before they install it. 

In this video, we’ll walk you through both approaches: no-code Interactive Templates for fast turnaround, and the Unity plugin for developers who want editable game variables, health checks, and full campaign integration.

author: Unity
description:
Automate uGUI menu setup from the command line. 

Because prefabs can't reference non-existent scene objects, a simple CLI command creates the scene, instantiates your prefabs, and connects everything automatically. Though this isn’t a full uGUI walkthrough, it demonstrates how you can streamline complex setup workflows using CLI automation.

🔗 Connect your project today: https://on.unity.com/UnityCLI_Docs

#UnityCLI #Unity6
title: Scene setup with Unity CLI
